original_test_intent: Verify that the Memory Type enum in every Type 17 record identifies the approved memory technology for that locator/population, is valid for the declared SMBIOS version and remains semantically stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version, anchor the raw Memory Type byte rather than generic Type text, bind it to locator/size/form factor/type detail, decode version-aware enums, compare approved module/platform technology and optional trusted SPD evidence, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the technology inventory and reboot plan. No hardware change or visual acceptance is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Memory Type enum per locator/device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and enum table
Policy for empty slots, Other, Unknown and version-new values
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and approved inventory data; do not manipulate memory or firmware.
Anchor parsing to the raw Memory Type field; do not accept matches from Type Detail or unrelated labels.
Preserve numeric enum and decode it under the recorded SMBIOS version.
Correlate locator, Size/population, Form Factor and Type Detail without letting those companion fields replace the Memory Type value.
Stop on invalid/reserved enum, identity ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode raw Memory Type per complete Type 17 identity, validate enum/version and approved inventory, and compare semantic pre/post reboot state.
Do not alter hardware/firmware, invent enum mappings or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-locator memory technology and special/versioned enum policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The target word is too broad: grep -iA1 'Type' can combine multiple Type 17 fields and provides neither raw enum nor enclosing locator identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 output and report handle/locator/population, raw/decoded Memory Type, SMBIOS version validity, form factor/type detail and approved module comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Memory Type scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read the raw Memory Type byte at the Type 17 field offset, decode against the applicable SMBIOS version, bind it to stable locator/population identity and compare the approved technology inventory before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 memory-device records across supported DRAM and nonvolatile memory technologies.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and optional SPD-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Memory Type enumeration and authoritative platform/module inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces generic text matching with exact raw-field, version-aware, per-device validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-field matches, reserved/version-mismatched enum codes, technology assigned to the wrong slot and decoded-label drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-locator technology baseline and SMBIOS version policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SPD type codes and SMBIOS enums are different namespaces; any correlation requires a documented translation.

project_override_considerations: A project may mix memory technologies or accept a newly introduced enum, but must key expectations by locator/class and record the SMBIOS/tool versions that support its decoding; silently mapping Unknown to a desired type is prohibited.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/device identities, per-locator Memory Type and enum/version policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version
Per-device raw/decoded Memory Type, version-validity, population and companion-field consistency
Optional trusted SPD/module correlation with documented namespace mapping
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic type diff

review_improvement: Prevents Type Detail or another matching line from masquerading as the Memory Type result and detects version-invalid or wrong-slot technologies.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory Type is a finite raw enum on each enumerable Type 17 record; exact decoding and baseline comparison are deterministic software operations.
